EA1:
Use case name: AdministratorAuthentication
Participating actors: Initiated by administrator
Flow of events: 1. The administrator accesses the system. 2. The system shows the login form for entering the data (user name and password). 3. The administrator enters the data and submits the authentication request. 4. The system receives the form, verifies the data and grants the administrator access to the system with the specified access permissions.
Entry condition: The administrator has gained access to the system.
Exit conditions: The system grants access to the administrator, OR if the administrator enters a wrong login and/or password, the system calls the use case WrongData, OR if the service is not available, the use case ServiceUnavailable is invoked.
Quality requirements: The username string is present in the system, is well formed, contains characters [a..zA..Z0..9 .-_], has a length of less than 30 characters and is not empty. The password string is present in the system, is well formed, contains characters [a..zA..Z0..9.-_ * +!?,:; accented letters], and has a length between 8 and 15 characters.

Use case name: CitizenAuthentication

The citizen enters the data and submits the authentication request. 4. The system verifies that the data are correct and grants access to the citizen.
Entry condition: The citizen has gained access to the system.
Exit conditions: The citizen has logged in successfully, OR if the citizen enters a wrong login and/or password, the system calls the use case WrongData, OR if the service is not available, the use case ServiceUnavailable is invoked.
Quality requirements: The username string is present in the system, is well formed, contains characters [a..zA..Z0..9 .-_], has a length of less than 30 characters and is not empty. The password string is present in the system, is well formed, contains characters [a..zA..Z0..9.-_ * +!?,:; accented letters], and has a length between 8 and 15 characters.

Participating actors: Initiated by employee
Flow of events: 1. The employee accesses the system and activates the citizen registration procedure. 2. The system shows the form for inserting a new citizen. 3. The employee enters the citizen's data and submits the registration request. 4. The system receives the form and checks that the citizen entered by the employee is not already present in the system.
Entry condition: The employee has authenticated in the system.
Exit conditions: The system registers the citizen, OR if the employee enters an employee number already present in the system, the system calls the use case WrongData, OR if the service is not available, the use case ServiceUnavailable is invoked.
Quality requirements: The first name string may contain characters [a..z A..Z ' accented letters], has a length of less than 30 characters and is not empty. The last name string may contain characters [a..z A..Z ' accented letters], has a length of less than 30 characters and is not empty. The tax code (Codice Fiscale) string must be valid according to the regulations and has a length of 16 characters. The date of birth string must be an existing date in the numeric format dd/mm/yyyy (dd from 1 to 31, mm from 1 to 12, yyyy from 1900 to today). The place of birth string may contain characters [a..z A..Z ' accented letters], has a length of less than 30 characters and is not empty. The e-mail string has the format x@x.x, a length of less than 30 characters and is not empty. The household (family unit) ID string must be present in the system, contain only numeric characters and be greater than 0.

Entry condition: The administrator has authenticated in the system.
Exit conditions: The system registers the employee, OR if the administrator enters an employee number already present in the system, the system calls the use case WrongData, OR if the service is not available, the use case ServiceUnavailable is invoked.
Quality requirements: The first name string may contain characters such as [a..z A..Z ' accented letters], must be shorter than 31 characters and not empty. The last name string may contain characters such as [a..z A..Z ' accented letters], must be shorter than 31 characters and not empty. The e-mail string has the form x@x.x and a length of less than 3 characters [sic]. The employee number string contains only numeric characters and equals 6 characters. The username string is not already present in the system, is well formed, contains characters [a..z A..Z 0..9 . - _], has a length of less than 31 characters and is not empty. The password string is well formed, contains characters [a..z A..Z 0..9 . - _ * + ! ? , : ; accented letters] and has a length between 8 and 15 characters. The confirm-password string must be consistent with the password entered.

Use case name: ChangeOfResidence
Participating actors: Initiated by citizen, continued by employee
Flow of events: 1. The citizen presses the Change of residence button. 2. The system shows the citizen the form to fill in. 3. The citizen enters the data of his or her new home. 4. The system notifies the citizen that the request has been sent correctly, and it is stored in the system. 5. The employee accesses the system and views the request received. 6. Entry condition: The citizen has authenticated in the system.
Exit conditions: The system creates the document to be delivered to the competent office, OR if the service is not available, the use case ServiceUnavailable is invoked.

The telephone prefix string may contain only numeric characters and must be between 2 and 5 digits. The telephone number string may contain only numeric characters and must be between 5 and 8 digits. The family member's last name and first name strings may contain characters [a..z A..Z ' accented letters], have a maximum length of 30 characters and are not empty. The family member's place of birth may contain characters [a..z A..Z ' accented letters .] and must be at least one character long. The family member's date of birth must be an existing date in the numeric format dd/mm/yyyy (dd from 1 to 31, mm from 1 to 12, yyyy from 1900 to today). The identity card code of an applicant from outside the municipality must consist of XXnnnnnnn (X = letter, n = digit) and have a length of 9 characters.

Flow of events: 1. The citizen clicks the view-applications button (identity card, change of residence). 2. The system shows a screen with the applications that concern the citizen.
Entry condition: The citizen has authenticated in the system.
Exit conditions: The citizen views the screen, OR if the citizen wants to cancel an application, the system calls the use case CancelApplication, OR if the citizen wants to modify an application, the system calls the use case ModifyApplication, OR if the service is not available, the use case ServiceUnavailable is invoked.
Quality requirements: None foreseen.
EA138:
Use case name: WrongData
Participating actors: Initiated by citizen
Flow of events: 1. The system shows a message on the terminal screen indicating that the request entered was incorrect. 2. The citizen reads the notification message. 3. The system presents the input form again.
Entry condition: This use case extends the other use cases and handles the exceptional failure cases caused by incorrect input.
Exit conditions: The input form is presented again.
Quality requirements: None foreseen.
